usage.callShape: GET https://skills.onesource.io/api/chain/receipt/{hash}?network=ethereum (hash = 0x-prefixed 64-hex tx hash; no request body; x402 USDC on Base)
usage.outputShape: body.data.result (full tx receipt: .status "0x1"=success, .from, .to, .blockNumber, .gasUsed, .effectiveGasPrice, .logs[], .contractAddress); body.meta.request_id; body.error is null on success
usage.guide: Look up an Ethereum (or other supported chain) transaction receipt by hash. Put the 0x-prefixed 64-char tx hash as the last path segment of GET https://skills.onesource.io/api/chain/receipt/{hash}; optionally add ?network= (ethereum default; also sepolia, avax, megaeth, megaeth-testnet, base). Pay $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 — no API key, no body. Read the receipt from response body.data.result (hex-encoded fields; status "0x1" means success). meta.request_id is the trace id.
